title: The Old Hunters' Camp
text: A camp of trophies, bones and rusted traps, a lean-to rotting in the rain. Someone hunted the same quarry here, years ago, and kept careful notes. The last pages are spattered. The last line just says: it learns.

options.label: The wisest reads the spattered notes, to learn what the hunter learned too late.

outcomes.text: Its habits, its weak side, the way it always turns left. The last pages are about how it stopped turning left.

options.label: Mend the old traps and carry them along, so what hunted him finds iron first.

outcomes.text: Old iron, still good, set around your camp each night. Nothing trips them yet.

options.label: Take the dead hunter's trophies. He will not need them now.

outcomes.text: Heads and horns, and an ivory you cannot place. They will sell.
